set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f"
printf '%s\n' '=== MAINTENANCE SIGNALS (portable scan) ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('backend'),Path('frontend'),Path('scripts'),Path('server.py')]
patterns=['TODO','FIXME','HACK','XXX','except Exception','type: ignore','eslint-disable','shell=True','os.system(','subprocess.']
exts={'.py','.ts','.tsx','.js','.jsx','.css','.sh','.md'}
for pat in patterns:
    print(f'-- {pat} --')
    found=0
    for root in roots:
        paths=[root] if root.is_file() else root.rglob('*')
        for p in paths:
            if not p.is_file() or (p.suffix not in exts and p.name!='server.py') or 'node_modules' in p.parts or '.venv' in p.parts:
                continue
            try: lines=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').splitlines()
            except OSError: continue
            for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
                if pat in line:
                    print(f'{p}:{i}:{line.strip()[:220]}')
                    found += 1
                    if found >= 80: break
            if found >= 80: break
        if found >= 80: break
    print('count_shown',found)
PY
